section.title: Getting Ready for Unit 2

para.span: To be ready for this unit, you need to be able to:

item.span: Determine if an ordered pair is a solution to a linear equation.
Work with slope-intercept form of a linear equation.
-intercepts of a line when given its equation.

section.para: Next, you will answer some questions that will help you see how ready you are for this unit. If you need help, some mini-lessons will help you brush up on anything you need to work on.
